openQuestions: Is the Jiachen (730M) still in production now that the Starlight 730 is named its successor (en.wikipedia)? The card keeps it as current.
Is the Hongguang S1/Confero still produced in Indonesia in 2026? The card keeps it as current without a dated source.
Should Wuling stay in the 'auto' section? The brand has no official EU sales. The only European link is the Lithuanian-assembled Freze Nikrob, based on the Hongguang Mini EV.
Most models-auto entries for Wuling lack years and body types. The cards have them; the shared file could be back-filled from the cards in the final pass.
summary: The cards were mostly consistent with en.wikipedia. Spot checks confirmed the Mini EV II / Aira photo, the Asta, Jiachen and Victory codes and engines, the Cortez/730 history and the Starlight 560 = MG Hector Tomahawk. Fixed: the Hongguang first-generation end (2013 -> unknown, still sold as the S/S Classic) and a Mini EV summary date. Proposed: the founding year (1998 vs 1982), the Alvez/Xingchi duplicate and 7 missing lines.
